_comment: vision.c block_point()/unblock_point() and zap.c zap_over_floor() 5411-5454: a flaming sphere explodes beside a closed door and burns it away. The port plans each monster turn on a cloned state before running it live, and the planned explosion's recalc_block_point() rewrote vision.c's module-wide transparency index. The dying sphere's light source forces a live vision_recalc(), and the red mold caught in the blast before the door is reached gives a --More-- screen in between, on which the port let the hero see through the still-closed door and show the brown mold in the lit room behind it. A dwarvish Valkyrie in debug mode wishes for and puts on a ring of fire resistance, creates a brown mold beside the west door of her lit start room, walks out through the door and closes it, reads a scroll of light so that the corridor squares are lit, creates a red mold one step up the corridor, steps back beside the door and creates a flaming sphere, which can stand only between her and the red mold. Seed, character and inputs chosen independently of batch 7.
